For l=0 the projection is zero, including on nonempty output spaces; this is still idempotent.

items.independent_derivation: P is true. For every prefix b, f(b,0)^2+f(b,1)^2 is nonnegative, hence m(f)(b)^2=f(b,0)^2+f(b,1)^2. Summing over prefixes and separating each (n+1)-bit string into its prefix and last bit gives N(m(f))=sum_b sum_(v in {0,1}) f(b,v)^2=N(f). Thus a recursive loader retains unit mass when the input already has unit mass; it also preserves any other mass, including zero. Signs of f are allowed, although the marginal entries themselves are nonnegative. At n=0 the output is the singleton empty-prefix table, not an empty index set.

items.independent_derivation: P is true. Let h=p-q. Vanishing ordinary derivatives through order k at -1 and 0 mean that h has a root of multiplicity at least k+1 at each endpoint. Over the reals these distinct roots imply that (X+1)^(k+1) X^(k+1) divides h. If h were nonzero, its degree would therefore be at least 2k+2. But deg(h) is at most max(deg(p),deg(q)), hence at most 2k+1, a contradiction. Therefore h=0. At k=0 this reduces to equality of affine polynomials at two distinct points; zero polynomials cause no exception.
